runs.content: Ford (F) picked up at the previous close ($15.28) on a Q2 beat-and-raise (guidance upper end lifted $500M to $10.5B) and a fresh Citi upgrade to Buy. MU stopped out at −17.51% (blended −2.81% incl. earlier T1, −$28) and AMD signal-exited at −14.70% (Burry Sector Warning, −$147) — both casualties of the broad Jul 29 semiconductor-sector selloff (Micron CEO share sale, China DUV lithography competition fears). Portfolio net P&L: +$695 (+1.65% on $42,000).

Travelers (TRV) picked up at the previous close ($397.22) as a Dow 30 insurer riding the day's broad rotation out of semiconductors into insurance/financials, after an ~88% Q2 EPS beat drove XLF to a record high. TNET hit its T2 target at $68.38 (+50.62%), second take-profit tranche sold (~$502); no stop-losses or signal exits fired, though MU (Burry Direct Short, −8.41%) and AMD (Burry Sector Warning, −9.72%) are both nearing the −10% signal-exit threshold. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,070 (+2.61% on $41,000).
